# Variable `CONFIGURE_SCRIPT`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

When using the autotools* class, the CONFIGURE_SCRIPT variable stores the location of the `configure` script for the Autotools build system. The default definition for this variable is:

```
CONFIGURE_SCRIPT ?= "${AUTOTOOLS_SCRIPT_PATH}/configure"

```

Where AUTOTOOLS_SCRIPT_PATH is the location of the of the Autotools build system scripts, which defaults to S.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-CONFIGURE_SCRIPT)
